\section{Documentation survey of DNP3 security}\label{app:crawler}

\paragraph{Collection.} A crawler listed the protective relays, controllers and RTUs, PLCs and power meters in the public online catalogues of GE Vernova, Rockwell Automation, SEL, Schneider Electric and Siemens as of 2026-10-13 (484 catalogue entries), with each entry\textquotesingle s lifecycle state taken from the vendor\textquotesingle s own wording. Stratified random sample: up to 4 devices per vendor, category and lifecycle stratum, seed 20261013, drawn from 484 classified catalogue entries; strata with fewer entries are taken whole. A sample of catalogue entries, not of installed devices. Inventory of 2026-10-13; categories and lifecycle come from the vendors' own catalogues and pages. The 99 sampled entries were crawled within a fixed page budget: product pages and the public data sheets, manuals and device profiles they link to, plus 18 official documents named in advance for entries the crawl had left unresolved. Only public documents were read, robots.txt was honoured, and every document is kept with its SHA-256 hash and retrieval time. 325 documents were read; 102 linked documents sit behind a vendor sign-in and were not requested.

\paragraph{Review.} For each entry and capability a reviewer recorded supported, conditional, explicitly unsupported or unknown per interface, keeping control protocols apart from management access, and separating authentication, integrity and encryption. Every positive result quotes a passage that is checked against the retained text. An unknown is never read as absence of the capability or as plaintext operation. The rows are an AI-assisted draft; the authors\textquotesingle{} confirmation is pending.
